accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of the RAC.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Rockefeller Foundation dockets including Board of Trustees and committee records, International Health Board dockets, International Health Division dockets, and select press releases, publications, vital records and corporate documents.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: Rockefeller Foundation has title, copyright and literary rights in the collection, in so far as it holds them. Rockefeller Archive Center has authority to grant permission to cite and publish material from the collection.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Processing Level 1 - File-Level Access.
Records remain in original housing. Additional processing will be conducted in the future to improve description, enhance access, and long-term preservation.
